title: Observer event
description: One row in ~/.claude/.kaizen/observer/events.jsonl. Emitted by hook scripts (PreToolUse / PostToolUse / UserPromptSubmit / Stop / SubagentStop) and by rule_verdict events from the rule engine.

mcp_server.description: For mcp_tool_call — the MCP server identifier

params.description: Tool params — summarized to first 200 chars unless KAIZEN_OBSERVER_FULL_PARAMS=1

drift_anomaly.description: Non-empty when the event didn't match the schema cleanly — e.g. 'new_param_shape: foo'

cached_tools_hash.description: For subagent_dispatch — hash of the tool list the runtime pinned at parent-session start

disk_tools_hash.description: For subagent_dispatch — hash of the current on-disk agent definition tools list
